scope: Targeted live metadata/abstract search through OpenAlex plus selected publisher/arXiv HTML methods/results inspection; not a systematic review. Prior-study sources retain their prior abstract-review status.

sources.name: GCP/P100 data descriptor
sources.claim: LVL2 log2 light/heavy ratios; GCP LVL3 invariant histone-peptide loading normalization; LVL4 whole-plate row median normalization. Deposits PXD017458/PXD017459 via Panorama. Three compound replicates per cell line do not establish independent cultures.

sources.name: GCP data deposit
sources.review: live landing page and GCT schema/sample metadata only
sources.claim: Panorama landing lists 28 plates with base, LVL3 and LVL4 GCT files. A verified example has 49 feature rows, 92 sample columns, 10 feature and 20 sample metadata fields. No measured feature rows read for this review.

sources.name: P100 data deposit
sources.claim: Public Panorama processed GCT links; PRIDE API returned 404, which does not imply unavailable data because deposit provider is Panorama.

sources.name: Initial proteomic perturbation library
sources.claim: 90 drugs by six cell lines, measured P100/GCP signatures and cross-assay connectivity including L1000; multimodal connectivity itself is established prior art.

sources.name: Robin
sources.claim: Literature search plus data analysis, iterative hypothesis revision and wet-lab therapeutic assays/RNAseq follow-up. Literature-agent ablations assess citations and proposal judgments; distinct from matched-budget held-out experimental decision yield.

sources.name: Co-Scientist
sources.claim: Persistent context memory, specialized agents, external-search ablation and hypothesis evolution; selected AML drug/combinations validated with three biologically independent experiments. Generic agent feedback architecture is not new.

sources.name: Kosmos
sources.review: live abstract and selected full-text validation sections
sources.claim: Structured information world model connects literature/data agents; selected discoveries checked in independent datasets. Its world model is a research-information representation, not a cellular perturbation simulator.

sources.name: EvoScientist
sources.review: full-text architecture sections and live abstract
sources.claim: Persistent ideation/experimentation memory includes unsuccessful directions and reusable execution strategies. Evaluations emphasize idea ratings and code success; this review did not establish independently held-out biological discovery gains.

sources.name: PertReason
sources.claim: Cell-state-conditioned mechanistic reasoning benchmark. Gold pathways synthesized from curated graphs paired with observed differential expression are not independent experimental causal truth; paper requires downstream validation.

sources.name: scArchon
sources.claim: Six-dataset perturbation benchmark; favorable quantitative scores can fail to retain biological signatures.

sources.name: Foundation cell model benchmark
sources.claim: Training-mean and biologically informed simple baselines outperform scGPT/scFoundation in studied settings; low perturbation-specific variation limits benchmark informativeness.

sources.name: BioDiscoveryAgent
sources.claim: Iterative genetic perturbation experiment design with literature/code tools and an unpublished evaluation dataset; reasoning loops and tool access alone are not novel.

sources.name: PerturbTrace
sources.claim: Separates feedback-to-state, state-to-action and action-to-outcome; strong final recall did not imply consistent gain from true rather than random/no feedback.

sources.name: PRESAGE
sources.claim: Measured cross-system perturbation transfer and source selection; sparse transfer coverage itself is prior art.

sources.name: MAP
sources.claim: Knowledge-conditioned multimodal zero-shot drug response prediction; pathways do not independently validate efficacy.

sources.name: TxPert
sources.claim: Multi-graph perturbation transfer; genetic evidence does not automatically establish chemical dose/time equivalence.

sources.name: Systema
sources.claim: Systematic variation can inflate perturbation prediction metrics; evaluate perturbation-specific measured decisions.

sources.name: GeneAgent
sources.claim: Database self-verification improves gene-set descriptions; descriptive verification differs from better experimental selections.

sources.name: BATCHIE
sources.claim: Bayesian batched experimental design with prospective combination-screen validation is a strong comparison class.

sources.name: CellOT
sources.claim: Optimal transport transfer of unpaired single-cell distributions; couplings are not measured trajectories.

novelty_boundary: Candidate contribution is budgeted, source-qualified evidence acquisition changing frozen measured-response transfer and held-out terminal decisions. No first-agent, first-memory, mechanism-proof, viability or biological efficacy claim. Public drug mechanisms may be in pretrained models; no assumed temporal independence.
limitations: Intermittent network resets/timeouts retried; unavailable retrieval was not evidence of absence.
Selected full-text sections were inspected, not every supplement or every source's entire paper.
PubChem descriptive sources are attributed pharmacology and do not supply assay-level causal ground truth.
